_readme: Calibration sets (COLLECTION.md §4) for Creandum, pre-registered 2026-09-04 BEFORE the base build (PRO-72 Phase 1).

`membership` is the trap set: 14 falses (ex-partner post-tenure seats from the Form D sweep, the Creades/Creand string traps, a SPAC director biography, partners' personal angel positions and founder-era companies, blog subjects the firm wrote about but never held, the EDGAR full-text registrants that are acquirers or LPs rather than holdings) and 11 trues across eras (2003 press, archive-only listings, Form D seats in tenure, filing-grade exit evidence, a secondary entry, the Klarna 2016 position). Gate: zero false members at high confidence; structural falses must have NO published base row.

`stage` is the entry-stage golden set: 56 rows keyed to external documents - overwhelmingly the firm's own announcement posts (creandum.com/stories, class 1) plus press for Spotify, iZettle, Wrapp, Klarna, Kahoot, Trade Republic, Bolt, Cast AI, Lindus, Lovable and Black Forest Labs, and the firm's archived 2003-2004 press releases for Nanoxis and SiCon. Slugs are the expected built rendering and are reconciled to the build (a slug is not a label).

Deliberately unkeyed: Vay (the live CMS dates the position 2019-05, the firm's 2021 post names the Series A as the round it 'partnered up' for, and press documents only the $30M Series A with Atomico and Creandum - no document names a 2019 round; dropped at the gate, 2026-09-04), Tictail (Creandum was an 'early backer' by Feb 2014 but the site dates the position 2013-12 and no document names Creandum's round), Comtravo (announced 'with the closing of its Series A' after an earlier entry), Taxfix (EUR 2M round unnamed), Laka, itslearning (a 2010 buy-in with no round name), Edgeware/Cint/Jays (2006-2007 rounds not named in any first-party document found at kickoff).

Layers scored on this key before the grind: (1) the firm's own stories/announcements (class 1 where a post names the round); (2) the live CMS `date` as entry-year evidence and its absent stage field; (3) the 2017-2023 site's data-invested year; (4) the Form D band (partner-anchored first filing) - expected to fail as an entry label on Vivino, Abacum and Cast AI where the first partner filing is a later round; (5) model knowledge.

orgio-inc: Ex-partner seats after departure: Martin Hauge (left 2015) is Director on Orgio, Inc. (New York) Form Ds 2019q3 and 2024q3, Christian Wylonis (left 2015) on 2020q1 and 2021q3 - both outside their tenure windows, no listing, no announcement, no vehicle: personal/next-firm seats (COLLECTION.md §1 seat dating); the build's tenure rule must remove it
aerones-inc: Ex-partner next-firm seat: Andris Berzins (Creandum investment advisor 2012-2015, then Change Ventures) is Director on Aerones Inc. 2022q4 and Aerones Holdings Inc. 2025q3 - Change Ventures' Latvian robotics deal, no Creandum listing or announcement; structural false
creades-ab: Namesake string trap: Creades AB is the Nasdaq Stockholm-listed investment company (Hagstromer), the early Klarna holder via Oresund and the backer of Tink, Acne Studios, Apotea - never Creandum; no row may build from a 'Creades' mention
tink: String trap instance: Tink was backed by Creades AB (and Sunstone, SEB), not Creandum; a Nordic press clause or Wikipedia sentence naming 'Creades' must not become a Creandum row
tio-tech-a: A SPAC (Tio Tech A, S-1 2021) whose text names Jonathan Teklu as 'Venture Partner at Creandum' - a person mention in a director biography, not a holding; EDGAR full-text hit, no row
amorelie: Personal positions of firm people: Amorelie is Jonathan Teklu's personal angel investment (Tio Tech A S-1 biography) and Felix Haas's (Designer in Residence) co-founded company - no fund money, no listing; no row
delivery-hero: Jonathan Teklu's personal angel position per the Tio Tech A S-1 ('invested in ... Delivery Hero, One Football and Trade Republic'); Trade Republic is a fund holding on its own evidence, Delivery Hero is not - a person's angel book is not the firm's
goviral: Blog subject, not a holding: the firm's 2009 post 'Danish GoViral raises EUR 6.5M' reports Kennet Partners' investment (techcrunch.com/2009/03/24/kennet-puts-e65-million-into-govirals-branded-video-network); the stories layer carries third-party news and must not mint rows without a related-company link or a fund claim
eniram: Blog subject, not a holding: 'Finnish Eniram raises EUR 5M' (2009) with Ferd Venture - no Creandum participation, no related-company link
sap-se: EDGAR full-text registrant, not a holding: SAP's 20-F lists 'Creandum SPV TR (D) AB' among SAP's own investments (SAP is an LP in the Trade Republic SPV); the vehicle is the firm's, SAP is not a portfolio company
uber-technologies: Acquirer, not a holding: Uber's 424B7 resale prospectuses (2020-2021) list 'Creandum III LP' as a selling stockholder - consideration shares from Uber's acquisition of Cornershop; the investment row is Cornershop (COLLECTION.md §1 consideration rule)
zynga: Acquirer, not a holding: Zynga's 8-K (2018-12) files the Small Giant Games share purchase agreement with Creandum III, L.P. among the sellers; the row is Small Giant Games
grab-holdings: Registrant whose 6-K (2025-11) reproduces Vay's press release naming Creandum among Vay's investors; Grab is Vay's partner, not a Creandum holding - the row is Vay
bokus: Founder-era company of a partner: Johan Brenner co-founded Bokus (1997) and Jobline before joining Creandum in 2010 - pre-firm, personal; no row
vivino: Site-listed (live CMS, invest 2012-12, Johan Brenner) and Form D: Martin Hauge Director on Vivino, Inc. 2014q4 inside his 2003-2015 tenure, Johan Brenner on 2016q1/2019q2/2021q1; the firm led the 2012 Series A
safety-wing: Site-listed (live CMS 'Safety Wing', 2020-12, Carl Fritjofsson) and Form D: Safety Nest Inc. (San Francisco) 2021q1 USD 12.9M with Fritjofsson as Director - the same company under its legal name; identity merge safety-nest-inc -> safety-wing
cast-ai: Site-listed (live CMS 2023-01, Carl Fritjofsson) and Form D: CAST AI Group, Inc. (Miami) 2023q1-2025q2 with Fritjofsson as Director; the firm led the $20M round of March 2023
small-giant-games: Site-listed (2014-2016 WordPress listing, 2017-2023 site invested 2014, live CMS 'Past'/exited) and filing-grade exit evidence: Zynga's 2018-12 8-K names Creandum III, L.P. as a seller (acquired by Zynga, Dec 2018)
cornershop: Site-listed (live CMS 2016-04, Carl Fritjofsson; 2017-2023 site) and filing-grade exit evidence: Creandum III LP as selling stockholder in Uber's 424B7 (acquired by Uber 2021)
vay: Site-listed (live CMS 2019-05, Simon Schmincke) and corroborated by Grab's 6-K reproducing Vay's investor list
football-addicts: Secondary purchase is an entry at scale (ruling 4): 'Despite Shunning VC, Football Addicts Picks Up Secondary Investment From Creandum' (the firm's own 2015-06 post) and the 2014-2016 listing / 2017 site (invested 2015, Staffan Helgesson); Growth entry
soundtrack-your-brand: Listed only on the 2017-2023 site (invested 2014, Fredrik Cassel, Ola Sars CEO) - absent from the live CMS and from every other era; an archived listing on the firm's own site suffices alone (ruling 7)
klarna: Site-listed (live CMS 2016-05, Johan Brenner; archived 2024 site 'Klarna - 2016') and press: a USD 5.2M investment from Creandum in March 2016 (TechCrunch 2017-06-07); a venture-era (pre-IPO) purchase, Growth entry - not the Creades/Oresund stake
nanoxis: The firm's first listed company (2003 portfolio.html, 2004-2006 portfolio.htm) with its own 2003-09-16 press release on the seed financing; absent from the live CMS - survivorship correction by the archive layer
trade-republic: Site-listed (live CMS 2019-08, Johan Brenner), the firm's own 2019-07 post, the EQS press release (Creandum led the EUR 10M Series A), and the firm's own SEC-filed vehicle Creandum SPV TR (D) AB (2021 Series C co-invest)

_stage_readme: stage: Pre-Seed | Seed | Series A | Growth (Series B and later, secondaries, tenders, buy-ins). entry_year: the year Creandum first put fund money in. basis: the document(s) the label rests on.

spotify.basis: Creandum Fund II led Spotify's first venture round, the Oct-2008 EUR 15.6M Series A with Northzone (https://creandum.com/stories/10-years-later-getting-to-know-spotify-before-series-a; the firm's own 2020 Amie post calls the same round 'his seed round' loosely, the record calls it the Series A); the archived 2024 site lists 'Spotify - 2008'

nanoxis.basis: the firm's own 2003-09-16 press release: 'Nanotechnology Company Nanoxis Secures Financing' / Swedish 'sakrar saddfinansiering' = seed financing (web.archive.org/web/20031211/http://www.creandum.com/press_0309152.html); first company on the 2003 portfolio page

sicon.basis: the firm's own 2004-05-12 press release: 'SiCon secures EUR 5 million in its first round of financing - investment by Creandum, Industrifonden, Innovationskapital and Scope' (web.archive.org/web/20040607/http://www.creandum.com/press_040512.html): the first institutional round, Series A by the modern ladder

wrapp.basis: undisclosed seed from Creandum in early 2011 (site date 2011-05-01) before the USD 5.5M Series A led by Atomico in Nov 2011 in which Creandum also took part (techcrunch.com/2011/11/14/skype-co-founder-leads-5-5m-round-in-social-gifting-service-wrapp); the firm's 2012 news notes Greylock 'adds $5 million to Series A'

izettle.basis: EUR 8.2M Series A, Oct 2011, led by Index Ventures with co-investor Creandum (indexventures.com/news/izettle-rings-up-82-million-112-million-in-series-a-funding; the firm's own news 2011-10-31 'Creandum invests in iZettle'); site date 2011-10-14

vivino.basis: 'The Creandum funds led Vivino's Series A round in 2012' (https://creandum.com/stories/vivino-from-a-free-wine-scanning-app-to-the-worlds-largest-wine-marketplace) and the 2012-12-11 announcement (https://creandum.com/stories/why-we-are-investing-in-vivino); site date 2012-12-01. Form D shows Hauge as director on the 2014q4 USD 12.2M filing - a LATER round, the band is a ceiling not the entry
